block.title: Conversion tracking
block.name: gelato_tracking_settings

setting.help: The container ID, in the form GTM-XXXXXXX. Leave the field empty and no tracking script is added to the website.
The pixel number from the Events Manager. Leave the field empty and the pixel is not added to the website.

setting.title: Visitors are asked before anything is measured.
setting.help: Ask visitors for consent before any tracking runs.

div.invisible: cookies_bar or (not gelato_gtm_id and not gelato_meta_pixel_id)

block.div:
Tracking is on but nobody is being asked for consent.
Google and Meta would start measuring on the first page view, which a site aimed at the EU may not do. Switch Ask visitors for consent on above.

div.invisible: not cookies_bar or (not gelato_gtm_id and not gelato_meta_pixel_id)

block.div: Google and Meta are held back until the visitor accepts optional cookies. Until then their scripts do not load and set nothing.
When a delivery order is completed, a purchase event is sent to both tools with the order number, the total, the discount, the delivery fee and the line items.
